title: A Light at the Door
alt_text: Respectful symbolic Diwali family scene, adult mother and father and little daughter seated near home doorway with small clay diyas neatly on a low stone ledge safely away from clothing, mother arranging flower petals not holding fire, daughter looking delighted, simple rangoli pattern drawn on ground, no fireworks, no deities no words, loose orange magenta blue BALLPOINT ink searching strokes with selective hatching and much blank paper.
